answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops fake identities. A slot costs a burned deposit of 60 units, twice 30-day earnings, for 20 epochs. A whisper cannot free a slot: work or expiry releases it, and the deposit is never refunded. The fable of a thousand free identities fails: each must pay separately. Each fake stands on its ledge. Forging 100 costs 100 x 60 = 6,000 units, above any gain. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
